Meet the Team

We're Chris & Anthony

Brothers. Students. Your local bin cleaning crew.

We're two students from Etobicoke who started Fresh Clean Bins to solve a real problem in our neighbourhood — dirty, smelly bins that no one wants to deal with.

We show up with our cart, our equipment, and a commitment to doing the job right. We use environmentally safe products and take pride in every single bin we clean. We'd be honoured to have you as a customer.

📍 Based in Etobicoke — serving the surrounding GTA with a small travel premium outside Etobicoke
